text.en:
Upon the recommendation of the Secretary of Finance, the
Federation of Filipino-Chinese Chambers of Commerce and Industry, Inc.
(Federation) is hereby authorized to conduct a series of fund campaigns among
its members and on the public to finance and support its "Operation: Barrio
Schools" project for a period of one (1) year from date of issuance hereof.

All funds generated from the fund campaigns through
donations or contributions to the "Operation: Barrio Schools" proiect shall be
exempted from all forms of taxes and the donor or contributor shall be allowed
to deduct such donations or contributions in full for income tax purposes, in
accordance with existing laws, rules and regulations.

All Filipino Citizens and/or residents of the country are
hereby enjoined to give generously in support of this proiect to ensure its
successful implementation.

This Executive Order shall be effective for a period of one
(1) year from date of issuance hereof, subject to renewal.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, I have hereunto set my hand and caused the
seal of the Republic of the Philippines to be affixed.
Done in the City of Manila, this lot day of February, in the year
of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Nine.
